title: Moving between pages is instant
description: Task lists, the board, a task, the timesheet, the DTR and the inbox now open straight away instead of waiting on the server each time. A page you have already opened comes back at once, and pointing at a link starts loading it before you click.
items: Saving a change — hours, a status, a field, a comment — shows at once instead of after a round trip
Switching back to a timesheet week you have already opened no longer shows a loading placeholder
A page you opened in the last few minutes is kept, so going back and forth between pages costs nothing
